We Are a Materials & Specialized Testing Laboratory

At KAIBELAB we evaluate and characterize materials with specialized technical direction, methodological criteria and a results-oriented approach, in compliance with applicable standards and technical references for validation, development and quality control processes.

Request a Quote Lab Services

Laboratory Capabilities

Specialized testing and analysis performed with technical rigor and advanced equipment

Accelerated Weathering

Accelerated aging simulation using Xenon radiation. Durability evaluation of materials and coatings per applicable ASTM, ISO and AATCC standards.

Colorimetry & Gloss

Objective measurement and quantification of color and surface gloss. Evaluation of changes caused by environmental exposure and aging.

Chemical Composition Analysis of Materials

Spectroscopic analysis of materials. Identification and characterization of molecular composition.

Material Evaluation

Comprehensive characterization of physical, mechanical and chemical properties of industrial and research materials.

Specialized Measurement

Specialized measurement testing adapted to the specific technical requirements of each client.

Specialized Technical Support

Expert technical advisory, results interpretation, and support for research and development projects.
